verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state approval is a mandatory gate before an agent may work: 'Nothing runs until a person approves a contract. Approval is the only gate... an agent is about to change your repository' and tasks with editable deliverables/contracts are approved before an agent claims them, with mobile approval also supported. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the gate is actually enforced (e.g., an agent blocked from acting without approval) and detail on what happens if an agent attempts unapproved work.
